articles.summary: Horace Mann has launched the Horace Mann Club™ that offers a robust set of perks designed to help educators save money, reduce stress, and prioritize their well-being. Through the Horace Mann Club, educators can access a wide range of exclusive offerings, including fitness and wellness partnerships, financial tools, classroom resources, professional development programs, and more. This new program expands Horace Mann’s support of educators as a way to give back to those who give so much to their students and their communities. “For more than 80 years, Horace Mann has supported educators with resources they need to thrive and succeed,” said Steve Chauby, Chief Marketing and Distribution Officer for Horace Mann. “The Horace Mann Club is our way of thanking and continuing to support educators with benefits, discounts, and resources designed specifically for them.” Educators who register can explore unique offerings including: Professional growth opportunities, such as webinars and
articles.title: Horace Mann Launches Exclusive Program that Offers Fitness, Financial Wellness, and Exclusive Discounts to Support Educators Nationwide
